## Semantics preserved
v2 concatenates the id, a single `:`, and the attempt, defaulting `attempt` to the string `'0'` when absent, with no type casting — so a non-string `attempt` raises `TypeError` exactly as the contract does. The `'2'` in your example is a string and concatenates directly; it is not a "v1 vs v2" mode switch.
